## My Background

I am Hassan Maghfuri, a Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT) and a graduate student pursuing a Master of Science in Biomedical and Health Informatics at Case Western Reserve University.

I earned my Bachelor of Science in Respiratory Therapy from Indiana University of Pennsylvania in May 2024, graduating with a GPA of 3.90/4.00.

After graduation, I worked at Allegheny General Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, where I gained over 1,500 hours of ICU bedside experience caring for critically ill patients.

My experience in critical care helped me understand the importance of clinical judgment, teamwork, and accurate information in patient care.

## Why Biomedical Informatics?

Working in respiratory care encouraged me to explore how healthcare technology, data analysis, and artificial intelligence can support clinicians.

I began my graduate studies at Case Western Reserve University in Spring 2026 to build on my clinical background and develop new skills in biomedical informatics.

My coursework includes artificial intelligence in medicine, statistical analysis, epidemiology, and geographic information systems.

## Professional and Research Interests

My interests include respiratory care, critical care medicine, clinical decision support, artificial intelligence in healthcare, and biomedical informatics.

I am particularly interested in how predictive models and healthcare data can improve mechanical ventilation management, identify respiratory complications, and support clinical decision-making in intensive care settings.

## My Goals

My long-term goal is to combine my clinical experience as a respiratory therapist with my knowledge of biomedical informatics to contribute to better patient outcomes and more effective healthcare delivery.
